Flow.description: Template for a one-field rule as a before-save (fast field update) flow that follows the BarnCRM switches. The example fills a blank mailing country on a contact. Save As a new flow, change the object, the entry condition, the field and the value, set cSwitchName to Flow: and your copy's API name, activate it, and list it on the Automation page of BarnCRM Settings so it gets a switch. Keep the Automation Control decision and the switch lookup: they make your rule stop with BarnCRM's own automation for a pause, a bypassed user, or its own switch. A before-save flow cannot call the Check BarnCRM Automation action, so it reads the same things directly. See ADR-0246 (before-save flows) and the admin guide page automation-control.md.
